answer: Each submission hangs on the voyage of a task receipt, and the sparrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a skeptical lens, addresses failure modes first register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the signal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on cryptographic attestation with threshold signatures.
